senses.gloss: m.(b. h. שֹׁר , with suffix שָׁרְר׳; שרר to knot, chain) navel, umbilical cord.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 1">Num. R. s. 1<sup>4</sup></cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Song of Songs 7:3">Cant. VII, 3</cite>) <he>והיא משולה בש׳</he> and it (the Sanhedrin) is compared to the navel; <he>מה הש׳ הזה וכ׳</he> as the navel is placed in the centre of the body, so are the Sanhedrin &c.; Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 2 (in parallels <cite ref="I00303"><he>טיבור</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Song of Songs 7:3">Ib.</cite> <he>מה הש׳ הזה … ומן הש׳ הוא אוכל וכ׳</he> as with regard to the umbilical cord, so long as the child is in its mother’s womb, its mouth is closed, and it is fed from the umbilical cord, so &c. Tanḥ. Thazr. 5 <he>שׁוֹרְרוֹ יוצא עמו וכ׳</he> its navel comes out with it (the infant) …, and the mother has to cut it off.
